name: Kentoushi
source:
Gladiator is a training game that tells the story of one warrior's battle.

The more your grow as a character, the more the will change!

Endings change based on the girl's feelings.

Will you follow your dream to become the strongest gladiator in history scenarios?

Or will you live out your days with female sex sl*ves?

Maybe you'll support a prostitute... but maybe...just maybe, you'll...
